parameters.description: QRY-12. The JSON Schema of this Query's parameters: an object, each of whose members is a string or an array of strings, sent as a query parameter of the same name — an array as the key repeated, once per element (QRY-13). An object with no members where the Query takes none. QRY-3: no member is named `query` or `cursor`.

result.description: QRY-4. The JSON Schema of the one document a read answers (QRY-9). Declared where the Query answers one thing, and then `items` is absent.

items.description: QRY-4. The JSON Schema of one item of the collection a read answers, in the shared page envelope (QRY-9, ENDP-20). Declared where the Query answers a list, and then `result` is absent.

title: Query declaration
description: QRY-12, QRY-4. One Query a Worker answers: the schema of its parameters, and the schema of what it answers — one document under `result`, or one item of a collection under `items`, and never both.
